Supplementary Figure S10. Emission corrections after implementing isotopic constraints,
compared with the methane-only inversion. The color shading (blue to red) shows the average
emission corrections for 2019–2021, calculated as the solutions from the methane-isotopic joint
inversions minus the methane-only solutions. The doughnut panels are sectoral fractions in
regional methane emission budgets: inner rings are from the methane-only inversions, outer rings
are from the methane-isotopic joint inversions. Regional boundaries are outlined in the map, also
labeled in the lower-left panel of Figure 2.
